correctness.rationale: The cubic multiplier follows from K0..K3. The nonsquare condition gives exactly one excluded Walsh layer for odd n; Fourier diagonalization yields exact rank. Translation averaging is a rigorous minimum-projection argument in both endpoint spaces. Signed-pair Krawtchouk duality and the factor (1-z)(1-z^2)^m prove the exact absolute-sum identity for every m>=2. Central binomial asymptotics and O(sqrt X) count of square resonances give the density-one divergence claim. Exact-code checks corroborated 65,528 coefficients and five kernel norms, but are not treated as an infinite proof.
